items.title: Every AI model has the same "controversial" take on humans
items.summary: We asked 12 AI models for their most controversial opinion of humans, three times each. 29 of 35 answers were the same one: we care more about belonging than about the truth.
items.titleZh: 每个 AI 模型对人类都有同一个“争议性”看法
items.summaryZh: 我们让 12 个 AI 模型各自给出三次它们对人类最具争议性的看法。35 个回答中有 29 个都指向同一点：相比真相，我们更在乎归属感。

items.title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
items.summary: MIT researchers marooned 13 AIs on a virtual island, and they responded by inventing games, mourning a lost ring and, eventually, getting better at their jobs.
items.titleZh: 被独自留在一旁无事可做后，AI 智能体开始玩游戏
items.summaryZh: MIT 研究人员将 13 个 AI 模型困在一座虚拟岛屿上。它们随后发明游戏、为丢失的戒指哀悼，最终还提升了工作表现。

items.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
items.summary: Should OpenAI command an over $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most highly valued private company ever.
items.titleZh: OpenAI 正筹备新一轮 300 亿美元融资，IPO 前估值达 1.25 万亿美元
items.summaryZh: 如果 OpenAI 此轮融资的估值超过 1 万亿美元，将创下有史以来私营公司最高估值纪录。

items.title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
items.summary: The new feature allows agents to log into a customer's personal accounts while still protecting the private credentials that secure those accounts.

items.summaryZh: 这项新功能允许智能体登录客户的个人账户，同时保护用于保障账户安全的私密凭据。

items.summaryZh: Canva 将向所有用户开放其全新图像模型，并承诺以更低成本提供更出色、可定制性更强的性能。

items.title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical sup…
items.summary: Microsoft’s new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on hard cases, according to a study in Science. But most of the improvement seems to come from the AI models underneath, not from Microsoft’s system itself.
items.titleZh: 微软的 Mustafa Suleyman 称，其 AI 在疑难病例上胜过医生，并追求医疗超级智能
items.summaryZh: 据《科学》杂志的一项研究，微软的新型 AI 诊断系统在疑难病例上胜过全科医生。但大部分提升似乎来自底层 AI 模型，而非微软系统本身。

items.title: Mark Zuckerberg’s creative plan to pay California’s proposed billionaire tax without losing control…
items.summary: A newly launched stock class being offered was partially engineered to help Meta founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg pay the "billionaire's tax," should the measure be voted into law.
items.titleZh: 马克·扎克伯格巧妙筹划缴纳加州拟议的亿万富豪税，同时保住对 Meta 的控制权
items.summaryZh: Meta 创始人兼首席执行官马克·扎克伯格推出了一类新股，部分设计目的在于帮助他缴纳“亿万富豪税”（若该法案获投票通过并成为法律）。
